Jaipur's industrial economy is built on small and medium enterprises. The RIICO industrial areas around the city — Sitapura, Vishwakarma (VKI), and the surrounding estates — are dense with garment and apparel factories, gem and jewellery units, handicraft exporters, engineering workshops, and the broad MSME base that drives Rajasthan's manufacturing. For these businesses, a container office answers a specific need: a professional, secure workspace that does not require committing to permanent civil construction or a long fit-out.

SAMAN manufactures steel container offices and supplies them across Jaipur. We build at our facility in Greater Noida and dispatch to your RIICO unit or construction site. For an MSME owner who needs an office cabin, a security post, or an administrative room without the cost and delay of building one, a finished container office placed on the plot solves it in one delivery.

Explore container office models, sizes and fit-out or call us to discuss your requirement.

Who Buys a Container Office in Jaipur

A container office is a finished steel workspace — built from a refabricated shipping container or a new container-style steel frame — that arrives wired, insulated, and ready to use. No civil construction, no waiting. In Jaipur's RIICO estates the buyers are clear:

Garment and apparel manufacturers in Sitapura and the surrounding belt use container offices as administrative cabins, sampling rooms, and supervisor offices — adding workspace without giving up production floor.

MSME and engineering units in VKI and the RIICO areas use them as factory offices, security posts at the gate, and store rooms. A container office cabin for compact site setups fits a small plot where space and budget both matter.

Gem, jewellery, and handicraft exporters use container offices as secure, lockable administrative and display rooms.

Construction and infrastructure contractors building across Jaipur need a site office and a security cabin that can be placed quickly and moved when the project ends.

Jaipur's Industrial Zones — Where We Deliver

Telling us your delivery zone lets us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across the Jaipur industrial region, including:

Sitapura Industrial Area / RIICO (PIN 302022): The major RIICO estate in south Jaipur, dense with garment, gem and jewellery, IT, and engineering units. Container offices here serve as factory cabins, security posts, and administrative rooms.

Vishwakarma Industrial Area (VKI) / RIICO (PIN 302013): One of Jaipur's oldest and largest industrial estates in the north, hosting engineering, manufacturing, and MSME units. A long-established zone with continuous activity.

RIICO surrounding estates: The broader RIICO industrial infrastructure around Jaipur, including newer development areas. We deliver across these zones for new unit setup and expansion.

Outside these estates, we deliver to construction and industrial sites across the Jaipur region wherever a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications

Built to give an MSME a proper office on a compact plot.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 grade steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted
Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining — keeps the interior workable through Rajasthan's dry summer heat
Roofing: Heat-reflective GI over-roof to cut radiant heat, plus weather sealing
Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel
Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load
Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation
Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or MS/glass entry door

Common sizes for Jaipur delivery:

SizeTypical use
10 ftCompact MSME office or security cabin
20 ftStandard factory office — most common
40 ftLarge office, or office + sampling/store combination
20 ft + partitionOffice plus sampling or records room
40 ft modularJoined units for larger workspace

Custom layouts and partitions are built to your plot footprint — important on a small RIICO site.

Customisation

Everything is built and fitted at our Greater Noida factory before dispatch — so the unit arrives complete and needs no on-site construction, which is the whole point for a buyer avoiding civil work.

  • Internal partition walls for separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision — cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Heat-protection upgrade for Rajasthan summer
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling for cooling efficiency
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay offices
  • Anti-corrosion and dust-protection treatment
  • Exterior paint and company branding panel

Why Buy From SAMAN

We manufacture our own container offices — most suppliers serving Jaipur are dealers reselling units with no certification or warranty.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT: DIPP56005
  • GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. Over 500 projects since 2009.

MSME and RIICO unit buyers who need vendor documentation for a quality audit or procurement file can request ISO certificate copies, NSIC registration, and GST papers with the order — useful for MSME registration and tender purposes.

Price Factors

No fixed published price — every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Converted shipping container vs new steel-frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Insulation and heat-protection level
  • Electrical and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions
  • Anti-corrosion and dust treatment

For a cost-conscious MSME buyer, a compact 10 ft or 20 ft unit with a basic fit-out is an efficient way to add a professional office. Freight from Greater Noida to Jaipur is quoted as a separate, transparent line item. Send your size and use for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

You can also see a prefabricated container office finished at the factory for a ready-to-place unit.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Jaipur?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, the insulation and AC fit-out, and any partition or toilet additions. A compact 10 ft or 20 ft unit is an economical option for an MSME office. Freight from our Greater Noida factory is added as a separate transparent line. Call +91 87960 39938 for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Can you deliver a container office to Sitapura or VKI RIICO areas?

Yes. We deliver to Sitapura Industrial Area (PIN 302022), Vishwakarma Industrial Area / VKI (302013), the surrounding RIICO estates, and all Jaipur industrial and construction addresses. For RIICO estate deliveries needing gate-pass authorisation, share the entry procedure when you order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle with your site.

Is a container office a good option for a small RIICO plot without space for construction?

Yes — that is exactly where it fits best. A container office needs no foundation or civil construction for temporary or semi-permanent use; a levelled hard surface is enough. It arrives as a finished, lockable office and can be placed in a single delivery on a compact plot. When the unit is no longer needed in that spot, it can be relocated by crane. For an MSME avoiding the cost and delay of building, it is the efficient choice.

Do you provide documentation for MSME registration or a vendor audit?

Yes. We supply ISO certificate copies (9001, 14001, 45001), NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, and GST registration with your order file. These are useful for MSME and tender documentation. If your audit requires a manufacturer's declaration for the installed cabin, request it at order stage and we include it with the delivery paperwork.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Jaipur — manufactured by SAMAN, sized for your RIICO plot:

+91 87960 39938 | +91 97089 89937

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, use, and RIICO delivery zone for a complete quotation without a follow-up call.
